cohort: 65 singleton pregnant women with a history of papillary thyroid cancer, compared to 130 randomly selected singleton pregnancies (control group).
finding: Pregnant women with a history of papillary thyroid cancer had higher rates of gestational diabetes, cesarean section, postpartum hemorrhage, fetal malformation, and lower live birth rates compared to the control group.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher in the papillary thyroid cancer survivor group compared to the control group.
